summary: 2000 synthetic skies were generated with CUDA Wishart sampling and fitted with the shipped pair/network estimators. Pooled pull mean -0.0058, width 0.9902; one/two-sigma coverage 68.56%/95.78%. Mean pair chi-square 27.873 versus 28; residual chi-square 20.945 versus 21. All fixed five-MCSE statistical checks passed. MCSEs account for correlations between maps within each sky. The accelerator precision gate passed. This validates only the stated synthetic bin-level model; common beta and intrinsic EB are injected nuisance parameters, not inferred quantities.

prespec.experiment: Synthetic eight-map differential CMB calibration; bin-level Wishart ensemble
prespec.scope: No measured sky data. Exact Wishart draws at weighted bin-mean covariance; not an exact ell-level simulation.

generation_benchmark.scope: CPU Bartlett and selected-device Gram produce the same bin-level Wishart distribution and output shape using different algorithms and random streams; no hardware speedup claim.

acceptance.mcse_method: Independent simulation clusters; delta method for centered pull width; empirical SEM for chi-square means.
